title: Founders' Week Preview
caption: Founders’ Week invites us to reflect on a remarkable beginning: seven visionary students established Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity, Inc. at Cornell University on December 4, 1906. Their commitment to scholarship, brotherhood, leadership, and service helped create a legacy that continues to challenge us to uplift our communities. This week, we honor that vision through action. #AlphaPhiAlpha #FoundersDay

title: Founders' Day Eve
caption: On the eve of December 4, we honor the Seven Jewels whose vision and determination established Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity, Inc. at Cornell University in 1906. Their efforts created a lasting fraternity—a brotherhood that has endured across generations while advancing scholarship, leadership, service, and the uplift of our communities. As we approach Founders’ Day, we celebrate not only their historic achievement, but the enduring institution and responsibility they entrusted to those who followed. #AlphaPhiAlpha #FoundersDay #Brotherhood

title: 120th Founders' Day
caption: Happy 120th Founders’ Day to the Brothers of Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity, Inc.! Founded December 4, 1906, at Cornell University in Ithaca, NY, our Fraternity honors the vision and perseverance of the Seven Jewels: Henry Arthur Callis, Charles Henry Chapman, Eugene Kinckle Jones, George Biddle Kelley, Nathaniel Allison Murray, Robert Harold Ogle, and Vertner Woodson Tandy. Their legacy lives on through 120 years of scholarship, leadership, service, and brotherhood. We honor their contributions not only through remembrance, but through our continued commitment to uplifting our communities. Onward and upward! #AlphaPhiAlpha #FoundersDay #SevenJewels

title: Brotherhood Through Generations

title: Gwinnett County 2026 Election Results & Turnout
caption: Gwinnett County, here's how we showed up in the November 3, 2026 general election: 347,060 ballots cast out of 612,682 registered voters — 56.65% turnout. Of those ballots, 229,154 were cast during advance voting, 107,021 on Election Day, 10,666 by mail, and 219 provisionally. See official results by contest at gwinnettcounty.com/government/departments/elections/election-results. Every election is an opportunity to stay informed about decisions affecting our community. #GwinnettCounty #Voting #CivicEngagement
